# The differences git-board-next has from v1's recorded outputs for now
# (next/testdata/golden/cli), each closed by a milestone of the rewrite
# (docs/rewrite/design.md, section 5). One a line:
#
#   <board> <case> <what> <milestone> <reason>
#
# board, case and what as in allowed.txt; milestone: the one that closes
# it (M2...M7). Unlike allowed.txt's, these are to go: make compat
# BIN=<git-board-next> fails on an entry no difference needs any more
# ("remove it from pending"), so the list only shrinks.

# The Markdown datastore comes with M3: every case of its board.
markdown * * M3 the Markdown folder datastore (docs/spec/datastores.md)
